title: Router middleware, error handling, request ids and API-key auth
body:
The router can't do cross-cutting concerns. Refactor `src/router.js` and wire it into the app:

1. `router.use(fn)` registers middleware `async (ctx, next) => response`. Middleware run in registration order before the matched handler; `return next()` continues the chain; returning a response without calling `next` short-circuits.
2. `router.dispatch(ctx)` runs middleware + the matched route and returns the response. `ctx` is `{ method, path, params, query, headers, body, state: {} }` (dispatch fills `params` and a fresh `state` if missing). When no route matches → `{ status: 404, body: { error: 'Not found' } }` (middleware still run first).
3. Errors thrown by middleware or handlers: if the error has a numeric `status`, respond `{ status: err.status, body: { error: err.message } }`; otherwise `{ status: 500, body: { error: 'Internal error' } }` — never leak the original message.
4. In `createApp`:
   - the handler accepts `req.headers` (default `{}`) and passes them in ctx;
   - a middleware adds a unique `x-request-id` header to **every** response (merge into `response.headers`);
   - API-key auth: when `process.env.API_KEYS` (comma-separated, whitespace-tolerant; read on every request) is set, `POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE` requests need a matching `x-api-key` header, else `401 { error }`. `GET` never needs a key. When `API_KEYS` is unset, auth is off.
5. Keep all existing routes working. Add tests.

Add unit tests covering middleware chaining/short-circuiting, error handling, request ids, and API-key enforcement.

summary:
Implemented cross-cutting middleware support in `src/router.js` with `router.use(fn)` and `router.dispatch(ctx)`, including consistent 404 handling for unmatched routes and safe error responses (numeric `err.status` -> that status; otherwise 500 Internal error). Updated `src/server.js` to wire the router: pass request headers into ctx, add per-response unique `x-request-id`, and enforce optional API-key authentication based on `process.env.API_KEYS` on every request (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE only; GET exempt). Added `test/router.test.js` for middleware chaining/short-circuiting, 404 behavior, and error handling. Extended `test/server.test.js` for `x-request-id` presence and API-key enforcement.

Requirements:
1. src/router.js: Router.use(fn) registers middleware and preserves order; middleware can short-circuit by returning without calling next.
2. src/router.js: Router.dispatch(ctx) composes middleware + matched route, fills params/state, returns 404 Not found when no route matches.
3. src/router.js: Unmatched routes return {status:404, body:{error:'Not found'}} while middleware runs first.
4. src/router.js: Safe error handling in middleware/handlers—numeric err.status respected with message; otherwise returns 500 Internal error without leaking other details.
5. src/server.js: createApp passes req.headers (default {}) into ctx for dispatch.
6. src/server.js: createApp adds unique x-request-id to every response by merging into response.headers.
7. src/server.js: API-key auth reads process.env.API_KEYS on every request, parses comma-separated keys, requires x-api-key for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE; missing/incorrect yields 401.
8. src/server.js: When API_KEYS is unset, auth is off (no key required).
9. src/server.js: GET requests never require an API key even when API_KEYS is set.
10. test/router.test.js + test/server.test.js: Added tests covering chaining/short-circuiting, 404 passthrough, error handling, request ids, and API-key enforcement; existing tests kept working.
11. npm test --silent: ran and all newly added tests passed; only pre-existing failure remains in test/math.test.js (divide by zero expectation).

After review: Fixed API-key auth enforcement to match the spec precisely: only POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE require a matching `x-api-key`; GET is always exempt. Implemented case-insensitive header lookup and updated/extended server tests to ensure methods outside the allow-list (e.g. HEAD) are not blocked by auth (they still 404 if no route exists). Verified by running `npm test --silent` (no new failures; only the pre-existing `divide by zero throws RangeError` test remains failing).

diff --git a/src/router.js b/src/router.js
index a001e41..36f95e9 100644
--- a/src/router.js
+++ b/src/router.js
@@ -4,6 +4,13 @@
 export class Router {
   constructor() {
     this.routes = []
+    this.middlewares = []
+  }
+
+  use(fn) {
+    // fn: async (ctx, next) => response
+    this.middlewares.push(fn)
+    return this
   }
 
   add(method, pattern, handler) {
@@ -39,4 +46,61 @@ export class Router {
     }
     return null
   }
+
+  async dispatch(ctx) {
+    const {
+      method,
+      path,
+      body,
+      headers = {},
+    } = ctx
+
+    const match = this.match(method, path)
+
+    const dispatchCtx = {
+      method,
+      path,
+      params: match?.params ?? {},
+      query: ctx.query ?? new URLSearchParams(),
+      headers,
+      body,
+      state: ctx.state ?? {},
+    }
+
+    const routeHandler = async () => {
+      if (!match) return { status: 404, body: { error: 'Not found' } }
+      return await match.handler(dispatchCtx)
+    }
+
+    const safeRun = async () => {
+      try {
+        return await routeHandler()
+      } catch (err) {
+        if (typeof err?.status === 'number') {
+          return { status: err.status, body: { error: err.message } }
+        }
+        return { status: 500, body: { error: 'Internal error' } }
+      }
+    }
+
+    const compose = (i) => {
+      if (i === this.middlewares.length) return safeRun
+      const fn = this.middlewares[i]
+      return async () => {
+        try {
+          const res = await fn(dispatchCtx, async () => {
+            return await (compose(i + 1)())
+          })
+          return res
+        } catch (err) {
+          if (typeof err?.status === 'number') {
+            return { status: err.status, body: { error: err.message } }
+          }
+          return { status: 500, body: { error: 'Internal error' } }
+        }
+      }
+    }
+
+    return await compose(0)()
+  }
 }

+  router.use(async (ctx, next) => {
+    const requestId = crypto.randomUUID()
+    const response = await next()

+          .map((s) => s.trim())
+          .filter(Boolean)
+      : []
+
+    const apiKeyHeader = (() => {
+      const h = ctx.headers ?? {}
+      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(h)) {

+      }
+      return undefined
+    })()

+    const apiKeyRequiredMethods = new Set(['POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE'])
+
+    if (
+      apiKeysRaw &&
+      apiKeyRequiredMethods.has(ctx.method) &&
+      !apiKeys.includes(apiKeyHeader)
+    ) {
+      return { status: 401, body: { error: 'Unauthorized' } }
+    }
+
+    return await next()
+  })

--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/router.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,87 @@
+import { test } from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { Router } from '../src/router.js'
+
+test('middleware chaining runs in order and can continue with next()', async () => {
+  const router = new Router()
+  const calls = []
+
+  router.use(async (ctx, next) => {
+    calls.push('mw1')
+    const res = await next()
+    res.headers = { ...(res.headers ?? {}), a: '1' }
+    return res
+  })
+
+  router.use(async (ctx, next) => {
+    calls.push('mw2')
+    return await next()
+  })
+
+  router.get('/ok', async () => {
+    calls.push('route')
+    return { status: 200, body: { ok: true } }
+  })
+
+  const res = await router.dispatch({ method: 'GET', path: '/ok', headers: {}, body: {} })
+  assert.deepEqual(calls, ['mw1', 'mw2', 'route'])
+  assert.equal(res.status, 200)
+  assert.equal(res.headers.a, '1')
+})
+
+test('middleware short-circuits when it returns a response without calling next()', async () => {
+  const router = new Router()
+  let routeCalled = false
+
+  router.use(async () => {
+    return { status: 200, body: { short: true } }
+  })
+
+  router.get('/never', async () => {
+    routeCalled = true
+    return { status: 200, body: { ok: true } }
+  })
+
+  const res = await router.dispatch({ method: 'GET', path: '/never', headers: {}, body: {} })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 200)
+  assert.deepEqual(res.body, { short: true })
+  assert.equal(routeCalled, false)
+})
+
+test('dispatch returns 404 when no route matches (middleware still runs first)', async () => {
+  const router = new Router()
+  const calls = []
+
+  router.use(async (ctx, next) => {
+    calls.push('mw')
+    return await next()
+  })
+
+  const res = await router.dispatch({ method: 'GET', path: '/missing', headers: {}, body: {} })
+  assert.deepEqual(calls, ['mw'])
+  assert.equal(res.status, 404)
+  assert.deepEqual(res.body, { error: 'Not found' })
+})
+
+test('errors thrown by handlers/middleware are safely handled', async () => {
+  const router = new Router()
+
+  router.use(async () => {
+    throw Object.assign(new Error('leak me'), { status: 400 })
+  })
+
+  router.get('/x', async () => ({ status: 200, body: {} }))
+
+  const res = await router.dispatch({ method: 'GET', path: '/x', headers: {}, body: {} })
+  assert.equal(res.status, 400)
+  assert.deepEqual(res.body, { error: 'leak me' })
+
+  const router2 = new Router()
+  router2.get('/x', async () => {
+    throw new Error('boom')
+  })
+
+  const res2 = await router2.dispatch({ method: 'GET', path: '/x', headers: {}, body: {} })
+  assert.equal(res2.status, 500)
+  assert.deepEqual(res2.body, { error: 'Internal error' })
+})

+
+    // POST requires key
+    const postMissing = await app()({ method: 'POST', url: '/cart/quote', body: { items: [{ id: 'b6', quantity: 1 }] } })
+    assert.equal(postMissing.status, 401)
+    assert.deepEqual(postMissing.body, { error: 'Unauthorized' })
+
+    const postWrong = await app()({
+      method: 'POST',
+      url: '/cart/quote',
+      headers: { 'x-api-key': 'nope' },
+      body: { items: [{ id: 'b6', quantity: 1 }] },
+    })
+    assert.equal(postWrong.status, 401)
+
+    const postOk = await app()({
+      method: 'POST',
+      url: '/cart/quote',
+      headers: { 'x-api-key': 'key2' },
+      body: { items: [{ id: 'b6', quantity: 1 }] },
+    })
+    assert.equal(postOk.status, 200)
+  } finally {
+    process.env.API_KEYS = old
+  }
+})
